contexts.name: OrganizationManagement
contexts.title: Organization Management
notes: Organization management owns organization lifecycle and runtime-discovered compute node availability.
risks: Inactive organizations can be invited into federations if organization lifecycle state is not enforced.
Disabled compute nodes can still be selected for training if runtime-discovered node availability is not enforced.

contexts.name: FederationManagement
contexts.title: Federation Management
notes: Federation management owns federations and federation membership governance.
risks: Inactive organizations joining a federation can compromise model governance and data sharing agreements.
Federation training can proceed with too few available organization-owned compute nodes if eligibility is not enforced.

contexts.name: DictionaryMaintenance
contexts.title: Dictionary Maintenance
notes: Dictionary maintenance owns dynamic option dictionaries used by platform contexts. Business contexts store valueCode and query DictionaryValueCatalog by dictionaryCode for display and selection.
risks: Runtime option changes can invalidate pending installation plans if dictionary values are removed instead of disabled.
Duplicate dictionary value codes can cause inconsistent command payloads across deployables.

contexts.name: FileUpload
contexts.title: File Upload
notes: FileUpload is the shared persistent file-storage boundary. It stores uploaded content through a replaceable storage adapter, records each uploaded file, exposes an authenticated content URI, and applies optional retention through expiresAt. Business domains reference the uploaded file record instead of creating another physical storage tier.
risks: Stored files can leak sensitive model or dataset content if retention, ownership, authorization, and content validation are not enforced.
Business references can become invalid if retention expires a file that is still referenced by a domain record.

contexts.name: RuntimeProvisioning
contexts.title: Runtime Provisioning
notes: Runtime onboarding owns runtime installation planning, bootstrap configuration, runtime environment registration, agent installation, readiness, connection reporting, and access revocation. K3s, Kubernetes, Docker Compose, and host process runtimes are installation targets, not separate domain concepts.

Runtime bootstrap and agent installation material is support configuration, not domain state: the platform backend adapter reads platform.runtime.bootstrap.publicBaseAddress, platform.runtime.agent.platformApiBaseAddress, platform.runtime.agent.controlApiBaseAddress, platform.runtime.agent.containerRegistry, platform.runtime.agent.trustBundleSecretName, and platform.runtime.agent.accessGrantSecretPrefix from deployment config or a secret store. Commands, events, and read models keep only runtimeInstallationPlanId, runtimeInfrastructurePackageId, and generated access grant IDs.
risks: Organizations can receive wrong runtime installation guidance and fail to connect runtime infrastructure.
Leaked bootstrap tokens can allow unauthorized infrastructure to join the platform.

contexts.name: DatasetGovernance
contexts.title: Dataset Governance
notes: Dataset governance separates feature schemas, platform-recorded runtime dataset metadata, dataset access validation evidence, and train evaluation bundles. Runtime agents own dataset declarations, data connectors, local access profiles, and credentials inside participant infrastructure.
risks: Datasets may be approved despite schema drift, privacy sensitivity, or non IID skew that invalidates training assumptions.
Validated dataset access can remain selectable after governance revocation unless blocked explicitly.

contexts.name: ModelRepository
contexts.title: Model Repository
notes: Model repository owns model identity, versioning, lineage, and pullable artifact references used by training orchestration and runtime agents. FileUpload owns the underlying bytes and storage adapter; ModelArtifact owns their model-specific lifecycle and metadata.
risks: Runtime agents can pull stale or tampered models if artifact URI, digest, registry, format, and signature are not snapshotted with the training run.
Aggregated round models can lose lineage if their producing training job and round are not recorded.

contexts.name: TrainingOrchestration
contexts.title: Training Orchestration
notes: Training orchestration owns job intent, participant eligibility, runtime dispatch, and each round of distributed training and evaluation.
risks: Training can stall when started participant runtimes fall below quorum or when secure aggregation context preparation fails before execution plans are dispatched.
Poisoned local updates can degrade the global model if anomaly checks are not modeled as a first class decision.

contexts.name: ModelLifecycle
contexts.title: Model Lifecycle
notes: Model lifecycle starts after training has produced a final evaluated candidate.
risks: A model can be promoted without a reproducibility package, model card, or approved evaluation report.
Rollback decisions may lose lineage if previous production versions are not captured.

contexts.name: RuntimeMonitoring
contexts.title: Runtime Monitoring
notes: Runtime operations separates low-frequency runtime state changes, node inventory changes, latest telemetry views, training alerts, and append only audit records. High-frequency heartbeat and resource samples are telemetry, not event-sourced domain events.
risks: Operational alerts without acknowledgement or resolution tracking can hide node degradation during training.
Audit records without payload hashes and source event classification weaken compliance evidence.

contexts.name: RuntimeGovernance
contexts.title: Runtime Governance
notes: Runtime governance owns stable RuntimeIdentity activation, capability detection, and revocation. Runtime private keys, local paths, credentials, node scheduling, and data-plane connectivity stay inside participant runtime infrastructure.

Platform-managed runtime agents are activated from platform deployment outcomes. Network reachability is not business authorization. Training eligibility uses active federation membership, RuntimeIdentity, detected capabilities, connected runtime status, and dataset readiness.
Training parameter encryption, secure aggregation keys, and data-plane message encryption are handled by protocol adapters or SecureAggregation, not by RuntimeIdentity events.
risks: A provisioned runtime can be mistaken for an active training participant.
Control-plane compromise must not expose runtime private keys or local dataset credentials.

contexts.name: SecureAggregation
contexts.title: Secure Aggregation
notes: Secure aggregation owns homomorphic-encryption-based aggregation sessions. The platform owns the private key and publishes only encryption context metadata to runtime agents; raw key material, public key documents, and storage locations stay in SecureAggregationService or KMS adapter configuration.
risks: Homomorphic encrypted updates protect individual parameters only when aggregation completes with enough participants; single-participant or very small cohorts can still expose local updates after decryption.
Aggregation can complete with insufficient encrypted updates or with an encryption context that does not match the active round.

contexts.name: RuntimeAgentOperations
contexts.title: Runtime Agent Operations
notes: Runtime agent operations is a separate deployable that runs inside participant infrastructure and executes dispatched training jobs with local data and local secrets.
risks: Agent jobs can leak local credentials if secret references are materialized outside the participant boundary.
Runtime engine jobs can remain running after platform cancellation unless local job lifecycle is tracked explicitly.

specifications.title: Upload File For Model Import
specifications.specification: Uploaded File Is Persisted And Recorded
specifications.rule: A file field uploads the selected content through the FileUpload deployment. The storage adapter persists the bytes in its configured backend, computes checksum metadata, assigns an authenticated content URI, and records the upload under fileId. Business domains keep the returned reference and own its business meaning. expiresAt is the retention policy for the same stored object.

specifications.title: Mark File Referenced By Model Import
specifications.specification: Referenced File Is Protected From User Discard
specifications.rule: A file is marked referenced when a business record accepts its fileId. Referencing does not copy the bytes into another storage tier; it records which business operation relies on the shared stored object. Physical cleanup remains controlled by expiresAt and reference-aware storage management.

specifications.title: Authorize Available File Download
specifications.specification: Only Available Stored Files Can Be Downloaded
specifications.rule: DownloadFile resolves an authenticated content URI through the configured FileUpload storage adapter. The command carries only fileId; original file metadata and downloadUri are resolved from UploadedFile state and the storage backend. File bytes are streamed by the download resource and are never copied into an Axon command or event. Referenced files remain downloadable, while discarded or expired files are rejected.

The pair must be unique. modelId remains the system identity for one imported or trained artifact version. sourceType distinguishes externally uploaded artifacts from artifacts produced by federated training. fileId identifies the shared FileUpload record; ModelRepository does not create a second physical copy or a second storage subsystem. The adapter resolves FileUpload metadata and content URI, validates the model format, records digest and size, and marks the file reference after registration. modelArtifactUri remains the authenticated FileUpload content URI.

specifications.title: Load Runtime Agent Bootstrap Configuration
specifications.specification: Runtime Agent Startup Bootstrap Configuration
specifications.rule: Runtime agent startup begins by loading bootstrap configuration from environment variables, mounted files, or platform-issued startup material. The configuration must provide the stable runtimeAgentId generated when RuntimeInfrastructure was registered, the matching runtimeInfrastructureId, and the agent version. A successful load starts the runtime-agent lifecycle; a missing or invalid configuration records a bootstrap failure and must not create a new random runtimeAgentId.

specifications.title: Report Runtime Instance Connected
specifications.specification: Runtime Agent Platform Connection Reporting Outcome
specifications.rule: After the runtime instance self-check passes, the runtime agent reports its connection status to the platform by calling POST /runtimeinfrastructure/recordruntimeconnectionestablished. The platform records RuntimeConnectionEstablished only after that command succeeds. The local agent must record AgentRuntimeConnectionReportFailed when the platform API is unreachable, authentication fails, the control channel cannot be established, the heartbeat is rejected, or the platform command is rejected.

specifications.title: Super Administrator Issues Token For Service Account
specifications.specification: Only Super Administrator Can Issue Service Account Api Token
specifications.rule:
Service account API tokens are intended for third-party system integration only.
Normal users do not issue tokens for themselves. A super administrator creates
a dedicated service account user, grants the required roles, and issues a long-lived
token for that account.

specifications.title: Issued Event Stores Digest Instead Of Plaintext Token
specifications.specification: Service Account Api Token Plaintext Returned Once
specifications.rule:
The generated API token plaintext is returned only as the command result.
Domain events and read models store only the token prefix and token digest.

specifications.title: Issued Token Captures Current Permissions
specifications.specification: Service Account Api Token Captures Permission Snapshot
specifications.rule:
The issued token carries the service account roles and permissions at issuance time.
When permissions change, the operator generates a new token for the service account.

zh-CN.A dataset can be approved only after con: 只有当数据集合约验证成功且具有可接受的质量和架构兼容性时，才能批准数据集。
zh-CN.A feature schema can be published only f: 特征架构只能在草稿生命周期状态下发布。
zh-CN.A feature schema is uniquely identified: 特征架构通过其域与系统分配的版本的组合进行唯一标识。同一个域下的两个架构不能共享版本，用户不会手动输入下一个版本。架构的数据模态描述特征列表是表示表格列，还是文本、图像、音频、文档或嵌入数据集等非结构化数据的逻辑输入。
zh-CN.A file field uploads the selected conten: 文件字段通过 FileUpload 部署上传所选内容。存储适配器在其配置的后端中持久化字节、计算校验和元数据、分配经过身份验证的内容 URI，并在 fileId 下记录此次上传。业务域保留返回的引用并拥有其业务含义。expiresAt 是同一存储对象的保留策略。
zh-CN.A file is marked referenced when a busin: 当业务记录接受其 fileId 时，文件被标记为已引用。引用操作不会将字节复制到另一个存储层，而是记录哪个业务操作依赖于共享的存储对象。物理清理仍由 expiresAt 和引用感知的存储管理控制。
zh-CN.A global model produced by the aggregati: 由聚合运行时生成的全局模型会在发出 GlobalModelUpdated 事件之前，通过共享的 FileUpload 存储边界上传。ModelArtifact 注册会记录该文件的 URI 以及摘要、格式、大小、生成训练作业和轮次；该注册不会创建第二个存储区域。生成的 modelId 会同时作为上传记录标识符和 ModelArtifact 标识进行复用，以实现可追溯性。
zh-CN.A model can be approved only after its e: 模型仅在其评估包被记录后才可被批准。
zh-CN.A model can be promoted to production on: 模型仅在获得治理批准后才能提升到生产环境。
zh-CN.A model can be promoted without a reprod: 模型可以在没有可复现包、模型卡片或已批准的评估报告的情况下被提升。
zh-CN.A model candidate must have an evaluatio: 在治理审批之前，模型候选必须包含评估报告、可复现性清单、超参数快照和模型卡。
zh-CN.A participant can join only after the or: 参与者只能在组织处于激活状态并持有目标联邦的有效邀请后才能加入。
zh-CN.A participant execution plan must carry: 参与者执行计划必须携带运行时代理所需的不可变基础模型工件快照：模型标识、可拉取工件 URI、注册表引用、模型格式、工件摘要以及可选签名 URI。运行时代理不得稍后从可变模型仓库视图中推断或查询这些值。第一轮使用训练运行配置中的初始模型快照；后续轮次使用上一训练轮次完成时记录的聚合模型快照。
zh-CN.A provisioned runtime can be mistaken fo: 已配置的运行时可能被误认为是活跃的训练参与者。
zh-CN.A runtime agent submits only the protect: 运行时代理仅为安全聚合轮次提交受保护的模型更新制品。平台评估提交的元数据、摘要、保护类型、参与者身份和异常信号，而不接收明文模型参数。ModelUpdateSubmissionAccepted 携带本轮的累计已接受运行时快照，以便下游安全聚合自动化能够统计加密更新数量并完成聚合。异常更新拒绝仍然是一条明确的业务规则，应在异常评分策略建模为条件决策或由端口支持的适配器之后，连接到 ModelUpdateSubmissionRejected。
zh-CN.A runtime dataset binding represents the: 运行时数据集绑定表示一个运行时上一个数据集的当前本地数据源配置。同一数据集可绑定到不同运行时，同一运行时也可绑定不同数据集，但一个运行时不能为同一数据集配置多个当前绑定。重新配置应使用显式的重新配置/更新流程，而不是为同一 runtimeId 和 datasetId 创建另一个绑定。
zh-CN.A training job can be created only from: 训练作业只能从已定义的可运行训练运行配置创建。在分派工作时，运行时代理会根据配置的特征架构匹配本地数据集。

zh-CN.Runtime agents can pull stale or tampere: 如果未将制品 URI、摘要、注册表、格式及签名与训练运行一同快照，运行时代理可能会拉取到过时或被篡改的模型。

zh-CN.Runtime engine jobs can remain running a: 运行时引擎作业在平台取消后可能仍保持运行，除非明确跟踪本地作业生命周期。

zh-CN.When a participant execution plan is rec: 当收到参与者执行计划时，运行时代理在开始任何训练工作之前执行本地就绪检查。该检查验证计划针对此运行时、所需的数据集绑定存在、数据集访问已经过验证、基础模型可用、所请求的训练配置受支持、本地资源充足，并且运行时代理处于空闲状态。该端口仅记录一种结果：当所有本地要求均已满足时为 ExecutionPlanAccepted（执行计划已接受），或者当任何要求失败时为 ExecutionPlanRejected（执行计划已拒绝）并附上拒绝原因。
zh-CN.Working Directory Writable is required: 工作目录可写为必填项
zh-CN.Workload Capacity is required: 工作负载容量为必填项
